text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) had arrived. Having 
made up her mind to run, Seiun Sky 
appeared before her Trainer and revealed 
she had an idea to break through the wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent who constantly breaks 
their limits, the only option is to "break 
past your own limits and runaway."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding on at top speed beyond the limit. 
Seiun Sky vowed to break through that wall 
and seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent who constantly breaks 
their limits, the only option is to "pull 
away at the very, very end."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mustering every ounce of stamina down the 
final stretch for one last surge. Seiun 
Sky vows to break through the wall and 
seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent who constantly breaks 
their limits, the only option is to "pull 
ahead on the uphill."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had always pushed through by using her 
inferiority complex as fuel. Seiun Sky 
vowed to break down this wall and show 
everyone she could win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent who constantly breaks 
their limits, the only option is to "pass 
them right back when passed."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without raw talent or sheer power, 
he'll overtake them on pure grit. Seiun 
Sky vowed to break through the wall and 
seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against an opponent who constantly breaks 
their limits, the only option is to mark 
them and "snipe them down."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pick a rival to watch out for, toy with 
them, and make them hesitate. Seiun Sky 
vowed she would break through the wall and 
seize victory.
